curation.notes: Imported from validation panel. Original serotype: Kottbus. Panel notes: No serotype antigens were detected. This is an atypical result that should be further investigated.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR1448839 && mv data/SRR1448839_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR1448839_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

SeqSero2.run_cmd: SeqSero2_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2/ -n seqsero2

SeqSero2S.run_cmd: SeqSero2S_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2s/ -n seqsero2s

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype: Kottbus. Antigenic formula should match -:-:-. EDGE CASE: Rough strain with no detectable antigens. Tool may fail or report atypical result - document behavior.
validation_instructions.mlst: Expected ST212. Accept exact match. Flag novel alleles for manual review.

notes: Part of FDA-CFSAN validation panel. No serotype antigens were detected. This is an atypical result that should be further investigated.
